exposure: history of stillbirth in the first pregnancy
history of stillbirth in the second pregnancy
cohort: Women in Sweden who had at least three singleton births between 1973 and 2012 were included in this population-based study.
finding: Women with a history of stillbirth in either their first or second pregnancy have an increased risk of stillbirth and other adverse pregnancy outcomes in a subsequent third pregnancy, with the highest risk observed in women with two previous stillbirths.
